notes.title: Game Removal Notice: Walking in Fog
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your continued support and love for Walking in Fog. After careful consideration, we have decided to remove Walking in Fog from Steam effective immediately. The game will no longer be available for purchase, but players who have already purchased the game will still be able to play normally.

If you have obtained a Steam key from other channels, please activate it as soon as possible to avoid any issues.

We sincerely appreciate your support and feedback throughout this journey. It has meant a lot to our team, and we look forward to seeing you again with new projects in the future.

— Walking in Fog Dev Team
